global_invariants: No destructive replacement from weakened selection proof

policy_notes.plain_destination: Preserve accepted M06 D5: a moved caret and same-role same-window move before ordinary validation can be permitted; bind the selected live destination for the effect. This is not permission for strict replacement, undo or observation to drift.
policy_notes.consent: Use capture-time grant for dictation, including allowed completion after pause. Later enable cannot authorize earlier capture. Preview/explicit teach have their separately documented authorization. Delete-everywhere is immediate.
policy_notes.deny: Current S12 forbids denied-app content reads. Context-disabled alone does not globally forbid separately authorized explicit selection. Minimal owner/classification metadata and permitted insertion/copy are separate capabilities.
policy_notes.coordinates: Artifact text offsets are code points; native AX is UTF-16. Exact conversion or honest unavailable; no guessed offsets.
policy_notes.clipboard: Generation protection is required but not native compare-and-swap. Characterize residual guard/write and unobservable delayed-consumer races without claiming universal elimination.
policy_notes.manual: No supplied manual/native case is passed. Native helpers may be automated locally only against owned synthetic surfaces; arbitrary-app behavior stays manual.

metamorphic_relations.name: Confirmation weakening

metamorphic_relations.expected_relation: A result cannot upgrade from uncertain to confirmed; observer certification cannot increase.

metamorphic_relations.name: Cancellation

metamorphic_relations.expected_relation: Before-effect writes remain prohibited; later cancellation cannot erase already-witnessed physical facts.

metamorphic_relations.name: Deletion

metamorphic_relations.expected_relation: Future content/read/replay authority can only decrease; no durable payload resurrection.

metamorphic_relations.name: Deny-policy monotonicity
